mainEntity.name: Do you ship to my country?

acceptedAnswer.text: We ship to most countries worldwide. At checkout you can only choose countries we deliver to. See Shipping & Availability for the full list of countries we cannot ship to.
Usually 7–20 business days after your prescription is approved, depending on your country and customs. You can check an estimate for your country on each product page.
Possibly. Our prices exclude import duties, VAT and customs fees. If your country charges them, they are paid by you on delivery.
Prices are in US dollars (USD). You can pay with most international cards; your bank converts the amount to your own currency at its exchange rate.
Yes. Every order ships with tracking. We email you the tracking link when your order is dispatched, and you can also see it in My account.

mainEntity.name: Is my prescription from my own doctor accepted?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — a valid prescription from a doctor licensed in your country is required. It must be in English, clearly readable and show the patient’s name, the medicine, the doctor’s name, registration and signature. Upload it as a PDF, JPG or PNG.
Yes. Benoquik is a prescription-only medicine. Our pharmacist verifies every order before dispatch.

No. It does not cure vitiligo and does not restore color. It permanently removes the remaining pigment from normal skin so that skin tone becomes even, for people with extensive vitiligo under a dermatologist’s supervision.
Yes. Depigmentation with monobenzone is generally permanent and cannot be reliably reversed, so make this decision carefully with your dermatologist.

mainEntity.name: How do I protect my skin from the sun?

acceptedAnswer.text: Depigmented skin burns easily. Use a broad-spectrum sunscreen every day, wear protective clothing and avoid strong midday sun.
